meta.label: PPB 2020 expenditure in 2018 (USD)
meta.scopeLabel: Sections of the programme budget, regular budget only
meta.scopeWarning: This year covers the regular budget only: the budget for 2020 (document A/74/6) publishes no other assessed and extrabudgetary expenditure for 2018. The total is therefore much lower than the years that carry all three funding sources, and the two are not comparable. 11 rows cannot be drawn (Peaceful uses of outer space, Executive direction and management, Programme of work, Post, Non-post, Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, Department of Operational Support, Office of Information and Communications Technology, International Civil Service Commission, Overview of financial and post resources, United Nations System Chief Executives Board for Coordination); see the note below.
meta.hierarchyProjection: USD Whole/Part/section hierarchy with RB, OA and XB side by side, followed by one source-role-selected component allocation outline per section/entity. Object, post, duplicate and CHF schedules remain outside additive arithmetic. Selected lower outline: 40 source tables, 274 printed observations and 186 materialized lower nodes; 102 parallel tables and 0 other-currency tables remain outside additive arithmetic.
